description: Call first in every conversation. On a new space, first_run.next_step is the one thing to offer before anything else: setup_run does the whole setup in one call. Otherwise, what needs attention: approvals waiting, what goes out next (next_up, soonest first; counts.scheduled_24h is the next 24 hours), problems (posts that went wrong, plus posts waiting for a person to post them: in a TikTok inbox or due by hand; counts.problems counts only the ones that went wrong, counts.to_post the waiting ones), accounts to reconnect, published Stories to add to their Highlight (to_file), and comments an auto-reply can answer (replies; send with comment_reply_send), attention: DMs, replies, tests, competitors or syncs that went wrong. Once the first post is approved, suggested_routines: routines you can run for them on a schedule; offer them once (routines_suggest). win is the week's post doing best against its account's usual; its next_steps' apply is the exact call to make (tool and input).

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
